desolate_planet.tip.basic_build_perimete: Buildin' a perimeter 'round yer base can help shield ye from mobs at night
desolate_planet.tip.basic_check_mat: If ye find yerself stuck, check what quests ye have available in yer MAT
desolate_planet.tip.basic_check_spiders: Check yer roof, spiders can climb up it in the night
desolate_planet.tip.basic_cobblestone_ge: Ye can connect the water and lava on the back o' the ship together to make a cobblestone generator
desolate_planet.tip.basic_seeds: Seeds fer most crops can be found in structures or dropped from siftin' dirt
desolate_planet.tip.basic_temperature_da: The temperature be hottest durin' the middle o' the day, make sure to stay away from heat sources durin' this time
desolate_planet.tip.basic_temperature_ni: The temperature be coolest durin' the middle o' the night. If ye can protect yerself from hostiles, it would be an ideal time to work outside
desolate_planet.tip.basic_temperature_sh: Ye can cool down by standin' in the shade
desolate_planet.tip.basic_temperature_un: The environment be colder deeper underground
desolate_planet.tip.diet_balanced_diet: It be important to maintain a balanced diet to avoid negative effects. See yer nutritional information by clickin' the Diet button in yer inventory.
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_fruits: If ye eat enough fruits, ye will be granted increased health regeneration speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_grains: If ye eat enough grains, ye will be granted increased movement, minin', and attack speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_proteins: If ye eat enough proteins, ye will be granted increased attack damage
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_vegetables: If ye eat enough vegetables, ye will be granted increased damage resistance and knockback resistance
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_fruits: Not eatin' enough fruits will stop natural regeneration
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_grains: Not eatin' enough grains will decrease movement, minin', and attack speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_proteins: Not eatin' enough proteins will decrease attack damage
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_vegetables: Not eatin' enough vegetables will increase damage taken
desolate_planet.tip.diet_sugars: Eatin' lots o' sugar will make ye faster, but too much will cause weakness and hunger
desolate_planet.tip.drink_acceptable_wat: Acceptable water be usually safe to drink, but has a 5% chance o' givin' hunger
desolate_planet.tip.drink_camel_pack: A camel pack will automatically drink water fer ye
desolate_planet.tip.drink_camel_pack_lav: Drinkin' lava from a camel pack will quickly kill ye (why would anyone do that?)
desolate_planet.tip.drink_campfire_purif: Campfires can be used to be plunderin' four water bottles at once
desolate_planet.tip.drink_composting_lea: Compost leaves instead o' saplings to maximize how much dirt and water ye get per tree
desolate_planet.tip.drink_composting_saw: If ye break logs into sawdust, ye can compost it fer more dirt or water
desolate_planet.tip.drink_stillsuit: A Stillsuit will regulate body temperature and significantly reduce yer water consumption
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crook_drops: Crooks can break leaves fer increased sapling drop rates and silk worms
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crook_oak_l: Usin' a crook on oak leaves will give more drops than other types o' leaves
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_la: A crucible can melt stone into lava, it can
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_or: Crucibles can be used to melt down ores or ore chunks, savvy
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_wa: A crucible can melt organic material directly into water, arrr
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_aut: Siftin' can be automated usin' a Deployer from Create or with a Mechanical Sieve
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_cru: Siftin' crushed blackstone will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances o' gold or cobalt
Siftin' crushed Deepslate will drop common, rare, and very rare ore chunks, plus Redstone, Lapis, and gemstones
Siftin' crushed end stone will drop end ingredients
Siftin' crushed Netherrack will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances o' crimson and warped items
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_dir: Siftin' dirt will drop pebbles and random seeds
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_dus: Siftin' dust will drop common ore chunks, plus Redstone, bone meal, and pebbles
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_gra: Siftin' gravel will drop common, uncommon, and rare ore chunks, plus flint, coal, Redstone, and diamonds
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_mos: Siftin' moss will drop random flowers
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_mul: When placed next to each other, up to nine sieves can be sifted at once, ye scallywag
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_pod: Siftin' podzol will drop slime and random saplings
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_san: Siftin' sand will drop uncommon ore chunks, plus quartz, and certus quartz
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_sou: Siftin' soul sand will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances o' quartz
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_upg: Upgrade yer mesh to get higher yields from siftin'
desolate_planet.tip.misc_building_gadget: Buildin' gadgets can be used to place or replace large amounts o' blocks at once
An Exchangin' Gadget can replace a wall o' dust with solid blocks, allowin' it to be mined without affectin' blocks above it
desolate_planet.tip.misc_crafting_end_st: End stone can be made from Glowstone in a barrel o' lava, or automated in an extruder with resonant ender
desolate_planet.tip.misc_crafting_nether: Netherrack can be made from Redstone in a barrel o' lava, or automated in an extruder with destabilized Redstone
desolate_planet.tip.misc_endermen_shooti: Endermen can teleport fast enough to dodge arrows, but not fast enough to dodge bullets, shiver me timbers
desolate_planet.tip.misc_finding_cobalt: Cobalt can be found plentifully in the Foundry structure, arr
desolate_planet.tip.misc_finding_netheri: Debris and netherite can be found in the Foundry structure, by Davy Jones' locker
desolate_planet.tip.misc_plastic_scraps: Plastic scraps can be found in structures and melted into plastic, me hearty
desolate_planet.tip.misc_substituting_pa: Paste can replace slime balls in most recipes, yarrr
desolate_planet.tip.structures_loot_prev: JEI can show ye what loot be found in structure chests
desolate_planet.tip.structures_navigatio: Ye can make a rover to navigate the wastes easier
desolate_planet.tip.structures_trash_pil: Ye can find useful scraps by lookin' through the piles o' trash found in structures
desolate_planet.tip.structures_warning_s: Just because ye can't see a spawner doesn't mean it isn't there
desolate_planet.tip.tech_if_dissolution_: Mob spawn eggs can be crafted in a dissolution chamber, blimey
desolate_planet.tip.tech_mekanism_energy: Redstone dust can be converted directly into energy in any Mekanism machine, arr
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_bone_meal_: Bone tool parts can be made from bone meal, savvy
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_crafting_s: Once ye have a foundry, more seared stone can be made by meltin' cobblestone (does not work in a Smeltery)
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_ore_doubli: Ores give higher yields in a smeltery, and even higher yields in a Foundry, me bucko
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_part_swapp: Ye can swap the parts o' a tool usin' a tinker station or tinker's anvil
